title: Nature's Bard
identity: Marilyn Shrude's Nature’s Bard (Dickinson’s Autumn) is an alto saxophone and piano work dated 2020, commissioned for and dedicated to James Umble. The composer's official page gives an approximate 12:30 duration and identifies the March 2020 premiere by Umble and Liz Ames. ACA lists 11 minutes and a 2025 publication, so the duration difference is retained as unresolved.

evidence.claim: Composer page gives instrumentation, date, commission/dedication, premiere performers/date, approx. 12:30 duration, and a program note connecting the work to shifting imagery from Emily Dickinson.
ACA lists the score/part, 2025 publication, authored or revised in 2020, 11-minute duration, and premiere details.
The ACA page shows preview/sample image thumbnails, but no readable notation sample was retrieved during this review.

review_focus: Inference: program note and premiere context support exploring the work's shifting autumn imagery, but no musical details can be claimed without the score or recording.
collection_flag: Contemporary original saxophone/piano work, dedicated to James Umble with documented conference premiere.

listening.description: John Sampen’s video-links page provides an external Nature’s Bard performance link.

score_links.description: ACA lists physical and digital score/part publication

gaps: ACA lists 11 minutes while the composer gives approx. 12:30; retain both reported figures until an edition-specific timing is verified.
Publisher preview images were listed but notation was not accessible; no score pages inspected.
No verified recording located in the composer’s recording list or linked premiere archive.
